Date: Feb 10, 2024
From: contracts@primevolta.com
To: procurement@finsecure.com

clauses.text: Dear [Client Contact Name],

source_location.excerpt: Dear [Client Contact Name],

clauses.text: Please find attached our proposed Hardware Supply and Maintenance Agreement for your review. Key highlights:

source_location.excerpt: Please find attached our proposed Hardware Supply and Maintenance Agreement for your review. Key highlights:

clauses.text: Supply of servers, ATMs, and secure transaction devices as per Annexure A.

source_location.excerpt: Supply of servers, ATMs, and secure transaction devices as per Annexure A.

clauses.text: 36-month hardware warranty.

source_location.excerpt: 36-month hardware warranty.

clauses.text: On-site technical support within 24 hours for critical devices.

source_location.excerpt: On-site technical support within 24 hours for critical devices.

clauses.text: Payment: 30% advance, 50% on delivery, 20% on completion of installation.

source_location.excerpt: Payment: 30% advance, 50% on delivery, 20% on completion of installation.

clauses.text: We look forward to your feedback and are open to discussing adjustments to align with your operational requirements.

source_location.excerpt: We look forward to your feedback and are open to discussing adjustments to align with your operational requirements.

clauses.text:
Best regards,
[Vendor Legal & Sales Team]
Primevolta Hardware Solutions

Primevolta Hardware Solutions

clauses.text: Dear [Vendor Team],

clauses.text: Thank you for your proposal. Our initial observations:

source_location.excerpt: Thank you for your proposal. Our initial observations:

clauses.text: Warranty period: We require 24 months instead of 36, with SLA for critical devices within 24 hours.

source_location.excerpt: Warranty period: We require 24 months instead of 36, with SLA for critical devices within 24 hours.

clauses.text: Payment milestones: We prefer payments tied to site-specific acceptance tests rather than delivery.

source_location.excerpt: Payment milestones: We prefer payments tied to site-specific acceptance tests rather than delivery.

clauses.text: Liability: Please clarify limits for data loss or security breaches.

source_location.excerpt: Liability: Please clarify limits for data loss or security breaches.

[Client Legal & Procurement Team]
FinSecure Services

clauses.text: Dear [Client Team],

clauses.text: We have reviewed your feedback. Our responses:

source_location.excerpt: We have reviewed your feedback. Our responses:

clauses.text: Warranty: We can agree to 36 months but will provide an option for critical devices to have a 24-month warranty if required.

source_location.excerpt: Warranty: We can agree to 36 months but will provide an option for critical devices to have a 24-month warranty if required.

clauses.text: Payment: We can accommodate milestone-based payments linked to UAT at each site.

source_location.excerpt: Payment: We can accommodate milestone-based payments linked to UAT at each site.

clauses.text: Liability: Vendor accepts responsibility for hardware defects and gross negligence. However, indirect losses and consequential damages are excluded. We can include limited data breach coverage per site.

source_location.excerpt: Liability: Vendor accepts responsibility for hardware defects and gross negligence. However, indirect losses and consequential damages are excluded. We can include limited data breach coverage per site.
